title: Sales and service advisor interactions
summary: Feedback on sales reps, advisors, and after-sales service is mostly either clearly positive about staff support and follow-up or too brief and context-limited to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise sales staff and advisors for strong follow-up, helpful support, and an overall good service experience.

negative.summary: The only negative review describes frustration with charging setup that was eventually addressed by a sales manager rather than criticizing routine sales service itself.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly short mentions of sales reps, advisors, or service centers without enough context to confirm a clear sentiment, though one fragment mentions delayed after-sales service.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short or lack context, which limits confident interpretation.
Some undetermined fragments contain evaluative wording, but the assigned sentiment must be preserved as undetermined.
The topic includes related but not identical subjects such as sales staff, service advisors, after-sales service, and service centers.
